events.desc: NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) Board of Directors announced today that Jensen Huang has resigned as President, Chief Executive Officer, and a member of the Board, effective immediately.
events.out: Jensen Huang has resigned as President, Chief Executive Officer, and a member of the Board, effective immediately.
events.in: Colette Kress, current Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of NVIDIA, has agreed to serve as Interim Chief Executive Officer
events.zh_core: 黃仁勳辭去總裁、執行長及董事職務，即刻生效；執行副總裁暨財務長 Colette Kress 任臨時執行長
events.zh: 輝達官方宣布：黃仁勳辭去總裁、執行長及董事職務，即刻生效；執行副總裁暨財務長 Colette Kress 任臨時執行長

rule: 大型公司官網新聞稿標題有 CEO／Chief Executive／leadership transition → 程式打開官方稿，網域對、頁面有 Chief Executive Officer、抓得到辭任／接任原文句子才算；留 7 天
